gloss: to exchange; to trade (greetings, words, etc.)

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {交|か}わしていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To give and receive something between two or more people. Used for words, greetings, glances, promises, and other reciprocal actions — not physical objects.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{握手|あくしゅ}→握手：01683_akushu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わした。
⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧とき、⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わした。
examples.english: When we first met, we exchanged greetings.

examples.japanese: {二国|にこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わして⟦{合意|ごうい}→合意：05093_goui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: Representatives of the two countries exchanged signatures on the contract and reached an agreement.

notes:
{交|か}わす is used for reciprocal, mutual exchanges, especially of intangible things like words, glances, and promises. It implies that both parties participate in the action. For exchanging physical objects, use ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ instead.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わす — to exchange words
- ⟦{握手|あくしゅ}→握手：01683_akushu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わす — to shake hands
- ⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わす — to exchange greetings
- ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わす — to make a promise (with each other)
- ⟦{視線|しせん}→視線：14138_shisen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わす — to exchange glances
- {杯|さかずき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{交|か}わす — to share drinks (formal/literary)

USAGE:
- The subject is typically two or more people performing the action together
- Often appears in past tense to describe a moment of connection between people
- Distinct from ⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, which is used for trading physical items
